verbatim_attestation_zh: H1/H2 工作表虽为自动生成，但已经过人工复核，你可以直接当作人工结果使用 不能拒绝
interpretation: The listed worksheets originated as automated drafts and were manually reviewed and adopted for use as H1/H2 decisions. They are accepted as human-reviewed results. Their provenance must remain explicit; they are not described as forms originally completed manually or as evidence of an independently generated blind human draft.
draft_specific_limitations: The H1 term-coding draft used a fixed 28-label provisional domain dictionary. Those labels are H1 proposals only and cannot determine K. H2 term adjudication, source support, domain merge/split decisions, PRESS, and seed recall must still determine the final search frame.

The hidden-seed builder executed live route-count checks but contained a predeclared eligible DOI list. The project-owner attestation adopts the reviewed H2 worksheets; DOI identity, route-set reconciliation, OpenAlex indexability, and recall remain independently machine-checked.
methodological_disclosure: Agreement statistics involving these H1 decisions quantify concordance with the adopted human-reviewed draft. They must not be presented as proof that the H1 draft was generated independently, manually, or without exposure to automation.
